praise: All ten spelling words, letter for letter. Two of those are real traps: usually, which almost everybody drops a letter out of, and island, which carries an s you cannot hear at all when you say it.

essay.summary: You chose three details that actually tell us something, and cartwheels is the best of them - it is the kind of detail that makes a person appear on the page instead of just being described.

fixes.should: She is playful and she loves cartwheels
fixes.why: a sentence has to say who is doing it - playful on its own has nobody attached to it

fixes.should: sometimes she will not put her phone down
fixes.why: show what she actually does instead of labelling her - we can picture the second one

essay.next: Give each of your three details a sentence of its own. You already did the hard part by choosing them; three sentences instead of one line is all that is missing.

focus: writing in whole sentences: who, then what they do
stretching one detail into a full sentence instead of a label
